description: Make learnings follow the same pattern as decisions. Currently learnings accumulate in a monolithic learnings.md that grows forever and is merge-conflict prone. Change to: learnings.jsonl remains the index, entries that warrant extended context get a file field pointing to learnings/<slug>.md, and learnings.md is retired. Scope: update CLI (learning commands, state machine, rollup logic), update skills (complete skill learnings synthesis), update migration logic to convert old learnings.md to new directory format. Per-scope learnings (epic/slice/quest) should follow the same pattern.
name: learnings-directory-pattern
title: Unify learnings storage: JSONL index + per-learning .md files in learnings/ directory
